svg.title: Measuring a moving rod
svg.desc: The rest length of a rod is compared with its length in a frame where it moves. Endpoint measurements are simultaneous in each measuring frame. Only the dimension along motion contracts. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Length contracts along the direction of motion
Frame in which the rod moves
Each observer measures both endpoints at the same time in that observer’s frame. Transverse size
stays fixed. This is measured length, not a photographic appearance.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
